phase6_figure5_representative_raw_channe.description: Creates figure5_representative_raw_channels_pixel_scale.png from raw registered F0003 DAPI and soma TIFF stacks by selecting central 1-based Z plane (z=42 for 84-slice stacks), applying display-only robust contrast on duplicate slice panels (histogram p1.0–p99.8), adding channel labels and a 100 px white scale bar (thickness 6 px, label exactly '100 px') to each grayscale panel, and writing sidecar caption metadata file figure5_representative_raw_channels_pixel_scale_caption.txt with source paths, Z plane, adjustment details, and explicit calibration caveat (pixel units only; no micron bar). This QA publication correction does not run or alter micro_sam segmentation/statistics; recommended micro_sam plugin is not applicable because this task is display-only figure assembly from existing raw stacks.
